title: Widget arbitrary file deletion (CVE-2026-4242)
summary: Widget 2.1 permits arbitrary file deletion with administrator interaction.
content:
## Overview
Widget 2.1 permits arbitrary file deletion when an administrator renames an attachment. A fixed release is not specified.

## Recommendation
Inventory Widget installations and consult the vendor advisory for remediation; do not infer a fixed release from the affected version.
